Counting the Brussels sprouts on the plate gives about 12. They look roasted, probably with some oil. Each one weighs roughly 15–20 g, so I estimated about 17 g per sprout.

- Mass: 12 × 17 g ≈ 200 g. The plate looks small, which supports a lower weight per sprout, so I settled on about 190 g.
- Energy: roasted Brussels sprouts with oil run about 65 kcal per 100 g. That gives roughly 125 kcal for 190 g.
